title.narrative: Strengthened institutional capacity to implement the national employment policy

description.narrative: Lesotho continues to experience high rates of unemployment. Job-rich growth has been the overarching objective of the government’s economic policies over the years. The ILO will endevour to work with non-ILO traditional partners such as the Miinistries of Finance, Trade and Public Works to develo a gender-res[onsive national employment strategy that seeks promote the creation of more employment opportunities through the development of pro-employment policies and investments within the key sectors of Manufacturing, Agriculture, Infrastructure, Tourism, Technology and Innovation. Employment intensive programme strengthened and promoted.
